openHouses.description: Updated co-op ideally located just moments from both the heart of Pleasantville and the Metro-North station. This inviting home features a modern, comfortable layout and quality finishes throughout. The living and dining areas feel bright and open, with well-proportioned rooms that create a natural flow and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Hardwood floors. Residents enjoy a peaceful residential setting while still incredibly close to everything. One car garage. Attic for storage.
